## Learning goals

Complete the exercises below using `fpp3`. Show plots and short written interpretations.

## Setup

```{r}
library(fpp3)
```


## 1. Fit SES vs Holt

```{r}
spain <- global_economy |> filter(Country == "Spain")
fit <- spain |>
  model(
    ses = ETS(log(GDP) ~ error("A") + trend("N") + season("N")),
    holt = ETS(log(GDP) ~ error("A") + trend("A") + season("N"))
  )
```

## 2. Forecasts and AICc

```{r}
fit |> forecast(h = 8) |> autoplot(spain)
glance(fit) |> select(.model, AICc, AIC, BIC)
```

## 3. Residuals

```{r}
fit |> gg_tsresiduals()
```
